verdict.rationale: SSH and root access are fair questions for a GPU cloud, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents kubeconfig/kubectl access to managed CKS clusters on bare-metal Nodes via API access tokens. Nothing in the pack covers SSH with user-supplied keys or root-level control of an instance, and kubectl cluster access is an adjacent capability, not the one the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can SSH into my GPU instance with my own keys and get root-level control of the environment
